lines.text: In the last days the mountain of the LORD's house will be raised above the hills, and many nations will come to it.
The nations say the God of Jacob will teach them His ways, and the law will go forth from Sinai.
The LORD will judge between peoples, they will beat their swords into shields, and each man will sit under his own vine and fig tree.
While the nations walk in the name of their gods, we will walk in the LORD's name, and He will gather the lame and the outcast.
The LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion forever, and the former dominion will be restored to the watchtower of the flock.
